Learn More XBLUE Business Phone Systems Cloud & On-Premise Phone Systems for Small to Large Businesses Cloud vs On-Premise Phone Systems Cloud vs On-Premise XBLUE Cloud Phone Systems The XBLUE Cloud system is maintained and managed by XBLUE. Phones sent to you connect to your network just like computers connect to your network. XBLUE also has an option that allows connection of desk phones to standard (twisted pair) telephone cables. XBLUE gives you a login to the XBLUE Cloud portal where you can make changes. Or call us and we’ll make changes for you. Local phone company landlines eliminated. Move (Port) your telephone number(s) to XBLUE’s direct connection to the telephone network. No upfront server equipment costs or network hardware to maintain. Cloud server maintenance and software updates are performed by XBLUE. AI: XBLUE Cloud offers Artificial Intelligence features that are not possible on premise systems. Included AI Text-to-Speech simplifies setup of voice announcements and AI Receptionist and AI Transcription are advanced options that enhance your workday. XBLUE technicians set up your new system and provide on-going USA technical support – no charge for the duration of your subscription. XBLUE Cloud includes Geo – an XBLUE iPhone and Android app enabling your smartphones to operate as your system extension and/or with your XBLUE system desk phone.
